Players Committee card image of [[Like My Father Before Me]] (original printing), game text: “Deploy on table. [Death Star II] Luke is deploy = 6, may not be Disarmed, and, when in battle, adds 1 to each of your battle destiny draws. Once per turn, may deploy Luke's Lightsaber from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During your turn, if Luke is at a battleground, may place a card from hand on Force Pile. (Immune to Alter.)”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual2-Light/large/likemyfatherbeforeme.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
